item.subject: science
item.stem: Ravi observes a small pond near his school in Pune. He notes all the Rohu fish in the pond, the water plants, the insects, and also the water, sunlight and mud, and how they interact. Which term best describes everything Ravi has observed?

options.A: A population, because the Rohu fish are one kind of organism
options.B: An ecosystem, because both living organisms and non-living components are included
options.C: A community, because there is more than one kind of living organism
options.D: A habitat, because the pond is where the organisms live
